display.purpose: Large readouts and critical system statuses.

headline.purpose: Section headers and primary active modes.

components.name: Diagnostic Button
components.description: Sleek, heavily rounded pill button with a strong outline. No 3D depth.
components.css: .ds-btn-diagnostic { background: transparent; color: #1cb0f6; border: 2px solid #1cb0f6; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 32px; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-diagnostic:hover { background: #1cb0f6; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: HUD Container
components.description: A stark, flat container for telemetry with pure flat borders.
components.css: .ds-hud-panel { background: #202f36; border: 2px solid #37464f; border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-hud-text { font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

narrative.overview: The system blends the high-energy urgency of an arcade challenge with the hyper-minimalist, high-contrast aesthetic of a medical MRI scan. The UI should strip away unnecessary decorations, relying on pure flat shapes, strong glowing outlines against deep dark backgrounds, and heavily rounded sleek elements.
keyCharacteristics: Sleek, heavily rounded components with flat graphic outlines.

rules.name: The Absolute Void Rule
rules.body: The background must remain deep and dark. Colors should act as glowing lines or flat stark fills against this void.

rules.name: The Data Readout Rule
rules.body: Typography should feel like clean, urgent data. Use uppercase labels with heavy tracking for system modes.

rules.name: The Graphic Flatness Rule
rules.body: Pure flat shapes with strong outlines. No drop shadows, no soft glows. If an element needs to stand out, give it a high-contrast border or a pure solid fill.

dos: Do use pure flat shapes with strong outlines.
Do maintain a super minimal, dark background (The MRI Scan look).
Do make buttons and interactive elements sleek and heavily rounded.
Do use vivid, high-contrast colors (Green, Blue, Red) to indicate system states.
donts: Don't use 3D thick borders or physical pressable button metaphors (rejecting the chunky tactile feel).
Don't clutter the screen with academic medical textbook diagrams.
Don't use drop shadows for elevation.
